plugins.label: Holographic DNA
plugins.author: community
plugins.description: Vertical double-helix DNA strand with holographic glow, rotating rungs, and soft neon trails. Fully procedural Cairo drawing.
plugins.lua_draw_body:
local cx = {cx}
local y0 = {y}
local H = {height}
local amp = {amplitude}
local turns = {turns}
local n_rung = math.max(2, math.floor({rung_count}))
local spin = {spin_speed} * wall_clock()
local ar, ag, ab = {color_a}
local br, bg, bb = {color_b}
local rr, rg, rb = {rung_color}
local glow = {glow}
local lw = {line_width}
local opacity = {opacity}
local steps = math.max(40, math.floor(H / 3))

local function helix_xy(t, phase)
  local ang = t * turns * 2 * math.pi + spin + phase
  local x = cx + math.cos(ang) * amp
  local y = y0 + t * H
  local z = math.sin(ang)
  return x, y, z
end

-- soft vertical aura
if glow then
  for g = 3, 1, -1 do
    cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * (0.04 / g))
    cairo_set_line_width(cr, amp * 0.35 * g)
    cairo_move_to(cr, cx, y0)
    cairo_line_to(cr, cx, y0 + H)
    cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
end

-- rungs (base pairs) — draw first so strands sit on top
for i = 0, n_rung - 1 do
  local t = (i + 0.5) / n_rung
  local x1, y1, z1 = helix_xy(t, 0)
  local x2, y2, z2 = helix_xy(t, math.pi)
  local depth = (z1 + z2) * 0.5
  local a = opacity * (0.35 + 0.55 * (0.5 + 0.5 * depth))
  if glow then
    cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, rr, rg, rb, a * 0.35)
    cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw * 2.2)
    cairo_move_to(cr, x1, y1)
    cairo_line_to(cr, x2, y2)
    cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, rr, rg, rb, a)
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw * 0.85)
  cairo_move_to(cr, x1, y1)
  cairo_line_to(cr, x2, y2)
  cairo_stroke(cr)
  -- nucleotide dots
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, a)
  cairo_arc(cr, x1, y1, lw * 1.1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_fill(cr)
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, br, bg, bb, a)
  cairo_arc(cr, x2, y2, lw * 1.1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_fill(cr)
end

-- strand polylines (back-to-front by sampling depth)
local function draw_strand(phase, cr_, cg_, cb_)
  -- collect points
  local pts = {}
  for i = 0, steps do
    local t = i / steps
    local x, y, z = helix_xy(t, phase)
    pts[#pts + 1] = {x, y, z}
  end
  -- glow pass
  if glow then
    cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    cairo_set_line_join(cr, CAIRO_LINE_JOIN_ROUND)
    for g = 2, 1, -1 do
      cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, cr_, cg_, cb_, opacity * (0.12 / g))
      cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw * (2.8 + g))
      cairo_new_path(cr)
      for i, p in ipairs(pts) do
        if i == 1 then cairo_move_to(cr, p[1], p[2]) else cairo_line_to(cr, p[1], p[2]) end
      end
      cairo_stroke(cr)
    end
  end
  -- main strand with depth-modulated alpha segments
  cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND)
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw)
  for i = 1, #pts - 1 do
    local a = opacity * (0.45 + 0.55 * (0.5 + 0.5 * pts[i][3]))
    cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, cr_, cg_, cb_, a)
    cairo_move_to(cr, pts[i][1], pts[i][2])
    cairo_line_to(cr, pts[i + 1][1], pts[i + 1][2])
    cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
end

draw_strand(0, ar, ag, ab)
draw_strand(math.pi, br, bg, bb)

plugins.label: Spinning Globe
plugins.author: community
plugins.description: Animated holographic Earth globe with latitude/longitude grid and simplified continents. Axial tilt and spin speed controls. Fully procedural and self-contained (no lua_helpers).
plugins.lua_draw_body:
local cx, cy, R = {cx}, {cy}, {radius}
local opacity = {opacity}
local tilt = math.rad({tilt_deg})
local spin = math.rad({spin_speed}) * wall_clock()
local ar, ag, ab = {color}
local show_grid = {show_grid}
local show_land = {show_continents}

local function rot_x(x, y, z, a)
  local c, s = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
  return x, y * c - z * s, y * s + z * c
end

local land = {
  {-100, 40, 1.4}, {-80, 25, 0.9}, {-70, -20, 1.2}, {-55, -10, 0.8},
  {-45, -25, 0.7}, {10, 50, 1.1}, {15, 10, 1.3}, {25, -5, 0.9},
  {35, 30, 0.7}, {70, 50, 1.5}, {100, 40, 1.2}, {120, 30, 0.8},
  {135, -25, 1.0}, {25, -30, 0.9}, {-15, 20, 0.6}, {40, -5, 0.5},
  {-60, 50, 0.6}, {90, 15, 0.7}, {150, -40, 0.5}, {-120, 50, 0.8},
  {-90, 60, 0.5}, {5, 60, 0.4}, {110, 0, 0.6}, {-40, -5, 0.5}
}

for i = 3, 1, -1 do
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * (0.06 / i))
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, i * 2.2)
  cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R + i * 1.5, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_stroke(cr)
end
cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar * 0.15, ag * 0.25, ab * 0.35, opacity * 0.25)
cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
cairo_fill(cr)

local function project(lon_d, lat_d)
  local lon = math.rad(lon_d) + spin
  local lat = math.rad(lat_d)
  local x = math.cos(lat) * math.sin(lon)
  local y = math.sin(lat)
  local z = math.cos(lat) * math.cos(lon)
  x, y, z = rot_x(x, y, z, tilt)
  if z < -0.02 then return nil end
  return cx + x * R, cy - y * R, z
end

if show_land then
  for i = 1, #land do
    local p = land[i]
    local sx, sy, z = project(p[1], p[2])
    if sx then
      local pr = R * 0.055 * p[3] * (0.55 + 0.45 * z)
      cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * (0.35 + 0.5 * z))
      cairo_arc(cr, sx, sy, pr, 0, 2 * math.pi)
      cairo_fill(cr)
    end
  end
end

if show_grid then
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, 1.1)
  for m = 0, 11 do
    local lon0 = m * 30
    cairo_new_path(cr)
    local started = false
    for lat = -85, 85, 4 do
      local sx, sy = project(lon0, lat)
      if sx then
        if not started then cairo_move_to(cr, sx, sy); started = true
        else cairo_line_to(cr, sx, sy) end
      else
        started = false
      end
    end
    cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * 0.45)
    cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
  for lat = -60, 60, 30 do
    cairo_new_path(cr)
    local started = false
    for lon = 0, 360, 4 do
      local sx, sy = project(lon, lat)
      if sx then
        if not started then cairo_move_to(cr, sx, sy); started = true
        else cairo_line_to(cr, sx, sy) end
      else
        started = false
      end
    end
    cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * 0.4)
    cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
end

cairo_set_line_width(cr, 1.6)
cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * 0.85)
cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
cairo_stroke(cr)

do
  local t = wall_clock()
  local band = (math.sin(t * 2.2) * 0.5 + 0.5) * R * 1.6 - R * 0.3
  cairo_save(cr)
  cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R - 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_clip(cr)
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * 0.12)
  cairo_rectangle(cr, cx - R, cy - R + band, R * 2, 6)
  cairo_fill(cr)
  cairo_restore(cr)
end

plugins.label: Neon Geometry
plugins.author: community
plugins.description: Neon-outlined shape that morphs between circle, square, triangle, star, hexagon, diamond, and octagon. Morph slider (0–1) blends vertices; optional auto-morph. Fully self-contained (no lua_helpers).
plugins.lua_draw_body:
local cx, cy, R = {cx}, {cy}, {radius}
local morph = {morph}
if {auto_morph} then
  local t = wall_clock() * {morph_speed}
  morph = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 2 * math.pi)
end
morph = clamp(tonumber(morph) or 0, 0, 1)
local m = morph * morph * (3 - 2 * morph)
local rot = math.rad({rotation_speed} * wall_clock())
local nr, ng, nb = {color}
local opacity = {opacity}
local lw = {line_width}
local layers = math.max(0, math.floor({glow_layers}))
local do_fill = {fill}
local N = 64
local name_a = {shape_a}
local name_b = {shape_b}

local function shape_pts(name, n, rad)
  local pts = {}
  name = tostring(name or 'circle')
  if name == 'circle' then
    for i = 0, n - 1 do
      local a = -math.pi / 2 + i * (2 * math.pi / n)
      pts[i + 1] = {math.cos(a) * rad, math.sin(a) * rad}
    end
  elseif name == 'square' then
    local corners = {
      {rad * 0.75, rad * 0.75}, {rad * 0.75, -rad * 0.75},
      {-rad * 0.75, -rad * 0.75}, {-rad * 0.75, rad * 0.75}
    }
    for i = 0, n - 1 do
      local t = i / n
      local seg = t * 4
      local si = math.floor(seg) % 4
      local f = seg - math.floor(seg)
      local c0 = corners[si + 1]
      local c1 = corners[(si + 1) % 4 + 1]
      pts[i + 1] = {c0[1] + (c1[1] - c0[1]) * f, c0[2] + (c1[2] - c0[2]) * f}
    end
  elseif name == 'diamond' then
    local corners = {{0, rad}, {rad, 0}, {0, -rad}, {-rad, 0}}
    for i = 0, n - 1 do
      local t = i / n
      local seg = t * 4
      local si = math.floor(seg) % 4
      local f = seg - math.floor(seg)
      local c0 = corners[si + 1]
      local c1 = corners[(si + 1) % 4 + 1]
      pts[i + 1] = {c0[1] + (c1[1] - c0[1]) * f, c0[2] + (c1[2] - c0[2]) * f}
    end
  elseif name == 'triangle' then
    local corners = {}
    for i = 0, 2 do
      local a = -math.pi / 2 + i * (2 * math.pi / 3)
      corners[i + 1] = {math.cos(a) * rad, math.sin(a) * rad}
    end
    for i = 0, n - 1 do
      local t = i / n
      local seg = t * 3
      local si = math.floor(seg) % 3
      local f = seg - math.floor(seg)
      local c0 = corners[si + 1]
      local c1 = corners[(si + 1) % 3 + 1]
      pts[i + 1] = {c0[1] + (c1[1] - c0[1]) * f, c0[2] + (c1[2] - c0[2]) * f}
    end
  elseif name == 'star' then
    local points = 5
    local inner = rad * 0.42
    for i = 0, n - 1 do
      local t = i / n
      local ang = -math.pi / 2 + t * 2 * math.pi
      local sharp = math.abs(math.cos(ang * points))
      local r = inner + (rad - inner) * (sharp ^ 1.6)
      pts[i + 1] = {math.cos(ang) * r, math.sin(ang) * r}
    end
  elseif name == 'hexagon' then
    local corners = {}
    for i = 0, 5 do
      local a = -math.pi / 2 + i * (math.pi / 3)
      corners[i + 1] = {math.cos(a) * rad, math.sin(a) * rad}
    end
    for i = 0, n - 1 do
      local t = i / n
      local seg = t * 6
      local si = math.floor(seg) % 6
      local f = seg - math.floor(seg)
      local c0 = corners[si + 1]
      local c1 = corners[(si + 1) % 6 + 1]
      pts[i + 1] = {c0[1] + (c1[1] - c0[1]) * f, c0[2] + (c1[2] - c0[2]) * f}
    end
  elseif name == 'octagon' then
    local corners = {}
    for i = 0, 7 do
      local a = -math.pi / 8 + i * (math.pi / 4)
      corners[i + 1] = {math.cos(a) * rad, math.sin(a) * rad}
    end
    for i = 0, n - 1 do
      local t = i / n
      local seg = t * 8
      local si = math.floor(seg) % 8
      local f = seg - math.floor(seg)
      local c0 = corners[si + 1]
      local c1 = corners[(si + 1) % 8 + 1]
      pts[i + 1] = {c0[1] + (c1[1] - c0[1]) * f, c0[2] + (c1[2] - c0[2]) * f}
    end
  else
    for i = 0, n - 1 do
      local a = -math.pi / 2 + i * (2 * math.pi / n)
      pts[i + 1] = {math.cos(a) * rad, math.sin(a) * rad}
    end
  end
  return pts
end

local a_pts = shape_pts(name_a, N, R)
local b_pts = shape_pts(name_b, N, R)

cairo_save(cr)
cairo_translate(cr, cx, cy)
cairo_rotate(cr, rot)

cairo_new_path(cr)
for i = 1, N do
  local ax, ay = a_pts[i][1], a_pts[i][2]
  local bx, by = b_pts[i][1], b_pts[i][2]
  local x = ax + (bx - ax) * m
  local y = ay + (by - ay) * m
  if i == 1 then cairo_move_to(cr, x, y) else cairo_line_to(cr, x, y) end
end
cairo_close_path(cr)

if do_fill then
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, nr, ng, nb, opacity * 0.12)
  cairo_fill_preserve(cr)
end

cairo_set_line_join(cr, CAIRO_LINE_JOIN_ROUND)
cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND)
for i = layers, 1, -1 do
  local spread = lw + i * (lw * 0.85)
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, spread)
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, nr, ng, nb, opacity * (0.14 / i))
  cairo_stroke_preserve(cr)
end

cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw)
cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, 1, 1, 1, opacity * 0.9)
cairo_stroke_preserve(cr)
cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw * 0.55)
cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, nr, ng, nb, opacity)
cairo_stroke(cr)

cairo_restore(cr)
